_comment: The order stylesheets actually resolve in, captured from a loaded page.
This is NOT the order in index.html: ensureThemeOrder() in settings-page.js
re-appends seven stylesheets to <head> at startup, so a rule that looks last in
the document can lose. tests/browser/cascade-contract.spec.js asserts this list
still matches the running page; scripts/dead-declarations.mjs uses it to decide
which of two competing declarations wins.
The tail entries moved by ensureStyleLast() are treated as indeterminate — see

indeterminateTail lists the stylesheets whose relative order is a race, not a fact: ensureStyleLast() re-appends them on render. The contract test asserts the order before the tail and the full set, never the tail's internal order.
